Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Would you like to join a company that puts people at the heart of its concerns? We are waiting for you! Since 2007, Extia, an IT consulting company, has been offering a unique approach in its field by combining well-being at work and performance.
 Our philosophy at Extia is “First who, then what", so let's go for it!
 🚀First who?
Passionate about digital transformation with a strong analytical and data-oriented mindset
Customer-oriented, quality-minded, and highly proactive in your approach
A collaborative team player with excellent communication and presentation skills in English
 Our current roles are hybrid, requiring 2-3 days per week in the office (Bucharest).
 🚀Then what?
 Data Engineer with Talend with a strong background in data architecture, SQL, with the following tasks:
Follow architecture, strategy, and ETL patterns in collaboration with the Group ETL Core Team
Assemble large, complex sets of data that meet non-functional and functional business requirements
Design, develop, deploy, and maintain Talend Jobs, connectors, and reusable ETL use cases
Build required infrastructure for optimal data extraction, transformation, and loading using ETL and SQL technologies
Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements, including infrastructure re-design for scalability and automation of manual processes
Build Data Warehouses and Data Marts, and interact with Data Lake/Lake House Solutions
Conduct technical framing: feasibility studies, expression of needs, workload estimation, and writing technical specifications
Work closely with stakeholders (executive, product, data, and design teams) to support their data infrastructure needs and resolve technical issues
Ensure thorough documentation of achievements and enrich the solution components catalogue
 Required technical skills:
Significant experience in a data engineering Cloud environment and building modern data architectures (including the medallion architecture)
Expertise in tools such as Talend Studio, Talend Data Integration Platform, Azure DevOps, Gitlab, Visual Studio, and SQL Server Management Studio
Highly skilled in Microsoft SQL Server Stack, Advanced SQL, and Query performance tuning
Strong knowledge of object storage systems (MinIO or equivalent) and distributed SQL query engines (Trino or equivalent)
Experience with fully automated CI/CD Pipelines (Azure DevOps), ETL Feeding mechanisms, and Row Level Security
Good knowledge of Data Modelling, Design Patterns of Data Products, and Agile methodologies
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the "Who" and represent the "What"? Apply and let's talk!
